_notes: 483 keys reviewed against current English; 0 null cur. Register kept: informal ikaw/mo, as in the rest of the Filipino Student app.
Team name: English 'Hangyul team' is 'Team Hangyul' everywhere; 'Team Hangyul Univ' kept only where English says 'Hangyul Univ team' (dashboard.counselor.team). Matches the fil-student-mobile patch.

Counselor: where the current English still says 'your counselor' (success, writing, visaroute, concierge), Filipino uses 'counselor mo' (the form visaroute already used); 'tagapayo' removed. Owner: the English mixes 'your counselor' and 'the Hangyul team' for the same party; if English is unified to 'the Hangyul team', these Filipino lines follow.

Owner: student:applicationDetail.statusText.ADMISSION_CERTIFICATE_ISSUED English says 'certificate of admission'; Korean is 표준입학허가서, so Filipino uses glossary 'standard admission letter'. English should follow.

Owner: student:stage.VISA_PREPARATION English 'Preparing your visa' breaks the glossary rule; Filipino says 'preparing the documents for the visa'. English should become 'Preparing your visa documents'.

Unified terms in scope: interview (not panayam), offer (not alok), essay (not sanaysay), checklist (not talaan), tugma for match, embassy/consulate (not embahada/konsulado), residence card (not kard ng paninirahan), flight (not lipad), immigration office, study plan, 'Mga mensahe' for the Messages section, 'Mag-sign in'.
student:v9.sponsor.foot dropped an extra sentence ('universities and embassies make every decision') that the current English no longer has.
